name: sky-drop
prompt:
High-energy cinematic vertical car reveal featuring the exact {vehicle} shown in the reference photos: {look}. Keep the vehicle's design, proportions, badges and wheels identical to the references.
Compose every shot with the vehicle in the upper two thirds of the frame and plain ground or floor in the lower third. The whole vehicle stays fully visible in exterior shots, never cropped.
The very first frame is already mid-action: the vehicle is plummeting out of the sky toward the camera, already large in the frame, level and right way up, clouds and vapour streaking past it. No empty establishing shot.
Shot 1 (0-1.3s): low-angle view from the ground of a sunlit salt flat as the vehicle falls fast and slams down on all four wheels at 1.3 seconds, suspension compressing and rebounding.
Shot 2 (1.3-4s): super slow motion, a circular shockwave of dust and salt blasts outward, small stones hang in the air, the vehicle sits undamaged and pristine in the centre, camera shaking slightly.
Shot 3 (4-7s): the dust clears, headlights and daytime running lights snap on, fast low orbit around the front three-quarter view, sunlight flaring off the paint.
Shot 4 (7-10s): the vehicle launches forward, then a wide hero shot of it driving across the flat with dust trailing, the vehicle in the upper middle of the frame.
Photoreal, crisp, high contrast, punchy colour, dynamic camera. No people. No on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no labels, no logos other than those on the vehicle, no license plate text. Audio: realistic sound effects only: rushing wind whoosh, a deep heavy impact boom at the landing, falling grit, engine start, tyres on salt. Absolutely no music, no voices.
